rank_note: Every feature is converted to a cross-sectional percentile within the same week before the model sees it, so only a stock's rank against its peers matters, never the raw level. A score of 100 means the highest value in the S&P 500 that week, 0 the lowest.
removed_note: Five fundamental features (P/E, P/B, profit margin, revenue growth, debt to equity) were removed in August 2026. The data source supplied only current values, which the pipeline applied to every historical date, so the backtest was effectively reading today's accounts into decisions made years ago. Removing them cut the measured signal strength by roughly three quarters, which is the honest size of the error. They can only return with point-in-time data carrying filing dates.

features.name: 4-Week Momentum
features.description: Price change over the last 4 weeks.
features.intuition: Recent relative winners tend to keep outperforming over short horizons.
features.low_note: Scored low: the stock fell, or rose less than its peers, over the past month.

features.name: 13-Week Momentum
features.description: Price change over the last 3 months.
features.intuition: The classic 3 to 12 month momentum effect (Jegadeesh and Titman).
features.low_note: Scored low: three-month performance trails the rest of the index.

features.name: 26-Week Momentum
features.description: Price change over the last 6 months.
features.intuition: Medium-term trend persistence.
features.low_note: Scored low: the six-month trend is weak relative to peers.

features.name: 52-Week Momentum
features.description: Price change over the last year.
features.intuition: Long-horizon momentum, the strongest of the classic momentum windows.
features.low_note: Scored low: a weak year against the index. This is the single most influential feature in the model, so a low reading matters more here.

features.name: RSI (14)
features.description: Wilder's Relative Strength Index over 14 weekly bars.
features.intuition: Near 100 means overbought, near 0 oversold. Captures short-term exhaustion.
features.low_note: Scored low: losing weeks have outweighed winning weeks recently.

features.name: Bollinger Band Position
features.description: Where price sits inside a 2 standard deviation band around its 20-week mean.
features.intuition: Values outside 0 to 1 flag statistically stretched prices.
features.low_note: Scored low: price sits near or below the lower band, statistically depressed.

features.name: Volume Z-Score
features.description: How unusual this week's volume is versus its own 4-week history.
features.intuition: Abnormal volume often accompanies new information hitting the stock.
features.low_note: Scored low: quieter than usual trading, so little new information arriving.

features.name: Volume Trend
features.description: Short-term average volume divided by longer-term average volume.
features.intuition: Above 1 means participation is building relative to its own quarter.
features.low_note: Scored low: participation is fading against its own quarterly average.

features.name: Price vs 52-Week High
features.description: Current price divided by its highest price in the past year.
features.intuition: Stocks near their yearly high tend to keep outperforming (anchoring bias).
features.low_note: Scored low: trading well below its 52-week high.

features.name: Distance from 52-Week Low
features.description: Current price divided by its lowest price in the past year.
features.intuition: Position within the yearly range, the mirror of the 52-week-high anchor.
features.low_note: Scored low: sitting close to the bottom of its yearly range.

features.name: MACD Histogram
features.description: Gap between the MACD line and its signal line (weekly-adapted EMAs).
features.intuition: Measures the acceleration of a trend, not just its direction.
features.low_note: Scored low: the trend is decelerating, whichever way it points.

features.name: MA Crossover 4/13
features.description: 4-week moving average divided by the 13-week moving average, minus 1.
features.intuition: Positive means a short-term uptrend has established over the medium term.
features.low_note: Scored low: the short average sits below the medium one, a downtrend.

features.name: MA Crossover 13/26
features.description: 13-week moving average divided by the 26-week moving average, minus 1.
features.intuition: A slower, more stable trend confirmation than the 4/13 pair.
features.low_note: Scored low: the slower trend confirmation is negative too.

features.name: Price vs 26-Week MA
features.description: Current price divided by its 26-week moving average.
features.intuition: Distance above or below the medium-term trend line.
features.low_note: Scored low: price is below its six-month trend line.

features.name: Idiosyncratic Volatility
features.formula: sqrt(max(Var_52(r) - b^2 * Var_52(r^S), 0)) * sqrt(52),   b = Cov_52(r, r^S) / Var_52(r^S)
features.description: Volatility left over after removing the stock's market exposure.
features.intuition: The low-volatility anomaly: high idiosyncratic vol has predicted lower returns.
features.low_note: Scored low: little stock-specific noise. Historically this is the favourable direction for this feature.

features.name: Realised Volatility (4w)
features.description: Annualised standard deviation of returns over 4 weeks.
features.intuition: Short-term risk level of the stock.
features.low_note: Scored low: unusually calm over the past month.

features.name: Realised Volatility (13w)
features.description: Annualised standard deviation of returns over 13 weeks.
features.intuition: Medium-term risk level, smoother than the 4-week version.
features.low_note: Scored low: calm over the quarter as well, not just the month.

features.name: ATR % of Price
features.description: Average true range over 4 weeks as a percentage of price.
features.intuition: A price-scale-free measure of how wide the trading range is.
features.low_note: Scored low: narrow weekly trading ranges.

features.name: Up/Down Volatility Ratio
features.description: Volatility of up-weeks divided by volatility of down-weeks (13w).
features.intuition: Above 1 means variability comes mostly from up-moves, an asymmetry.
features.low_note: Scored low: the big moves have mostly been downward ones.

features.name: Relative Strength vs SPY (4w)
features.description: The stock's 4-week return minus the market's 4-week return.
features.intuition: Isolates stock-specific strength from the overall market tide.
features.low_note: Scored low: underperformed the index over the month.

features.name: Relative Strength vs SPY (13w)
features.description: The stock's 13-week return minus the market's 13-week return.
features.intuition: Medium-term outperformance versus the index.
features.low_note: Scored low: underperformed the index over the quarter.

features.name: 1-Week Reversal
features.description: The negative of last week's return.
features.intuition: Last week's extreme movers tend to partially revert (liquidity pressure).
features.low_note: Scored low: the stock jumped last week, and sharp jumps often give part of the move back. The minus sign is deliberate.

features.name: Rolling Beta (52w)
features.description: Sensitivity of the stock to the market over 52 weeks, lagged one week.
features.intuition: How much the stock amplifies or dampens market moves.
features.low_note: Scored low: moves less than the market, a defensive profile.

features.name: Correlation with SPY (13w)
features.description: Rolling 13-week correlation between the stock and the market.
features.intuition: How tightly the stock tracks the index right now.
features.low_note: Scored low: currently marching to its own drum rather than the index.

features.name: Return Skewness (13w)
features.description: Asymmetry of the return distribution over 13 weeks.
features.intuition: Investors overpay for lottery-like positive skew, depressing its future returns.
features.low_note: Scored low: returns are skewed negative, occasional sharp falls.
